selection_basis: The official repository README labels the v2.4-dev asset as the stable APK download; the GitHub release itself is marked pre-release.
audit_notes: The tagged AndroidManifest declares only the AdbIME input-method service and no additional permissions.
The tagged AdbIME source decodes ADB_INPUT_B64 as UTF-8 and commits it through the current InputConnection.
Installation must remain subject to the phone's system confirmation and must not bypass MIUI restrictions.
